transcript: Yesterday I saw Guac at The Public. Written and performed by Manuel Oliver, this is a piece about his son Joaquin, also known as Guac, who he lost in 2018 during the Parkland school shooting. This is a heartbreaking personal account, tribute, and call to action all in one. But it also had plenty of humor and touching moments of community and love, like when we were all instructed to call someone to tell them just how much we love them. Unfortunately, I saw the last performance at The Public, but I still wanted to discuss this because it never ceases to amaze me what people are able to create art about. Also, on theme with this show, I wanted to mention that if you are able to vote tomorrow, please, PLEASE do. It is our responsibility to vote and to vote like people's lives depend on it, because they do. With that, another program for my collection.
